title: lora_recv_async 4.1.0 migration: lora_sim.c driver
description: Child 2 of 0l5j. Migrate lichen/drivers/lora/lora_sim.c recv_async (lora_sim.c:619, api at :681) to the Zephyr 4.x 3-arg contract (cb gains void *user_data; store and pass it on invocation).
